response.justification: Bogdan brings 13+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, mobile, embedded and high-throughput backend systems, plus a CS degree and a strong craftsmanship/teaching profile (TDD, CI/CD, workshops, OSS tooling). However, the role is a Principal/IC6 position centered on experimentation and measurement platforms, and the resume shows no A/B testing, feature-flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis experience. Career trajectory is senior/staff at small-to-mid companies rather than principal-level ownership of multi-team, enterprise-scale initiatives, and there is little evidence of cross-org influence or data-driven growth outcomes. The one high-scale distributed systems stint (Sociomantic) is a positive but is six years old and in DLang rather than the listed stacks. Strong generalist, but a poor match for the specific mandate.
strengths: 13+ years hands-on across many languages, incl. C/C++, Java, C#, JS/TS
Real high-throughput/low-latency experience at Sociomantic (millions RPS)
Strong testing/CI/CD craftsmanship, OSS authorship, and mentoring/teaching track record
concerns: No experimentation, feature-flighting, or telemetry/metrics platform experience
No evidence of principal-level scope: multi-team initiatives, cross-org influence, ambiguous-problem ownership
Little demonstrated data/statistics aptitude or growth-metrics work

key_factors.factor: Scope below Principal/IC6 (no multi-workstream or org-wide leadership)
Deep, broad engineering fundamentals with some high-scale production experience
